definitions.gloss: vice-chairperson; vice-president (of an organization or association)
definitions.explanation: The person second in rank to the chairperson of an organization, committee, or association. Assists the chairperson and acts in their absence.

examples.japanese: {副会長|ふくかいちょう}に{選|えら}ばれた。
{副会長|ふくかいちょう}が{会長|かいちょう}の{代|か}わりに{挨拶|あいさつ}した。
examples.english: The vice-chairperson gave the greeting in place of the chairperson.

examples.japanese: {来年|らいねん}の{副会長|ふくかいちょう}の{候補者|こうほしゃ}が{二人|ふたり}いる。
examples.english: There are two candidates for next year's vice-chairperson.

notes:
A compound of {副|ふく} (vice-, deputy) + {会長|かいちょう} (chairperson, president of an organization). Used for organizations, committees, and associations — not for corporate vice-presidents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {副会長|ふくかいちょう}に{就任|しゅうにん}する: to assume the position of vice-chairperson
- {副会長|ふくかいちょう}を{務|つと}める: to serve as vice-chairperson
- {副会長|ふくかいちょう}に{選出|せんしゅつ}される: to be elected vice-chairperson

RELATED WORDS:
- {会長|かいちょう}: chairperson, president — the top position in an organization
- {副社長|ふくしゃちょう}: vice-president (of a company) — the corporate equivalent
- {副委員長|ふくいいんちょう}: vice-committee chair — for committees specifically
